video_title: Boogie - NO WAY Dylan Harper Should Start Over D-Fox!

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's high usage rate and fatigue in Game 1
quotes.excerpt: the usual minutes that he gets to sit out and rest up, New York put pressure on them
quotes.quote: He went out of the game at the five-six minute mark in the third quarter. That's when New York made their run. They put him back in at the two-minute mark. He wasn't able to go anymore because New York is now surging and I got to keep this guy on the floor. That is a high usage rate. So the usual minutes that he gets to sit out and rest up, New York put pressure on them and they put him back in the game.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs need more bench production to allow Wembanyama to rest
quotes.excerpt: They got to get more production out of the bench for him to be able to rest.
quotes.quote: First of all, they got to get more production out of the bench. They've been getting outscored and outplayed from their bench in this series, in the first game and in the last series. They got to get more production out of the bench and that second group for him to be able to rest. Mitch Johnson did what he had to do to preserve this win. If you go up 14-15 points, yes, I got to put Wemby back in the game so I can reserve my lead.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's struggles and the case for Dylan Harper
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox had a rough night. When that happens the automatic assumption is, well, there's Dylan Harper.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox had a rough night. When that happens the automatic assumption is, well, there's Dylan Harper. What do we do? Why not more him? Why not start him?

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: De'Aaron Fox had a rough night. When that happens the automatic assumption is, well, there's Dylan Harper. What do we do? Why not more him? Why not start him?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's veteran leadership and value to the team
quotes.excerpt: You brought in the veteran guard in De'Aaron Fox to handle these type situations.
quotes.quote: You brought in the veteran guard in De'Aaron Fox to handle these type situations, to help guide this team, to be that veteran presence, to be that leader and coach on the floor. Obviously he didn't have the greatest game last night, but I think he's done his job throughout this season. He's helped lead this team to the point where they are now. So you can't overlook any of that.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's immediate impact compared to De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper came in the game and was immediate offense, was an instant impact.
quotes.quote: They're in the NBA Finals starting De'Aaron Fox who's making $50 million a year. He's banged up, his ankle is not the same right now and he had some wide open shots even earlier on in the game last night that just didn't fall. Dylan Harper came in the game and was immediate offense, was an instant impact. I do feel like he should have found a way to get him in the game at the end of the game there. Like he was tremendous, he's so fearless the way he go. He went at Mikal Bridges who's five inches taller than him and just bullied him. He should have been in the game.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: The financial reality of benching a $50 million player
quotes.excerpt: If he's off the floor making 50 million and you lose, you have to explain that.
quotes.quote: If he's off the floor making 50 million and you lose, you have to explain that.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's readiness for crunch time minutes
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper has played well enough to be in those closing minutes.
quotes.quote: What I do know is, Dylan Harper has played well enough to be in those closing minutes and I feel like they got to address that at some point. And I agree with Boogie, if you're not going to do it right now, maybe in the offseason. And I also agree with Chandler, in the finals, all bets are off. You got to put the five best players that's going to give you an opportunity to win a game on the court.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Coaching philosophy and the 'hot hand' in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: if the man is hot, you keep feeding him the ball.
quotes.quote: Me growing up playing this game, you were taught if the man is hot, you keep feeding him the ball. We got to a certain point in this league and in this game to now, everything with rotations, minutes, it's all off of a piece of paper now. It's no longer about feeling or who's having a good game, who's having a hot game. That's out the window. Everything is coach off a piece of paper. That's out the window. Like if Sam Penny's minutes are up and he just hit three threes in a row, there's no way in hell I'm taking him out of the game.
